coverageContext: Complete five-marker author-defined GRS4, an unweighted count evaluated in903Chinese narcolepsy cases/1,981controls; this is a small genetic research score, not a genome-wide predictor. PrimaryTables1/2 establish the exact scored markers and alleles, including the author's fixed rs2834188 term; GA does not substitute its index SNP or choose runtime proxies. Reported AUROC0.736 includes gender in a case-control study, not prospective incidence or GA-only performance. EUR ranks are withheld. No study threshold, personal disease probability, HLA status, sleep-study diagnosis, medication or vaccination recommendation is inferred.
